select
    dataset_id,
    season,
    phase,
    team_id,
    lineup_key,
    count(distinct game_id) as games_count,
    count(distinct stint_id) as stints_count,
    round(sum(duration_seconds)::numeric, 2) as total_seconds,
    round((sum(duration_seconds) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) as total_minutes,
    round(sum(possessions_offensive)::numeric, 2) as possessions_offensive,
    round(sum(possessions_defensive)::numeric, 2) as possessions_defensive,
    sum(points_scored) as points_scored,
    sum(points_allowed) as points_allowed,
    sum(point_differential) as point_differential,
    case
        when sum(possessions_offensive) > 0
        then round(((sum(points_scored) * 100.0) / sum(possessions_offensive))::numeric, 2)
        else null
    end as offensive_rating,
    case
        when sum(possessions_defensive) > 0
        then round(((sum(points_allowed) * 100.0) / sum(possessions_defensive))::numeric, 2)
        else null
    end as defensive_rating,
    case
        when sum(possessions_offensive) > 0 and sum(possessions_defensive) > 0
        then round((
            ((sum(points_scored) * 100.0) / sum(possessions_offensive))
            - ((sum(points_allowed) * 100.0) / sum(possessions_defensive))
        )::numeric, 2)
        else null
    end as net_rating
from stints
group by
    dataset_id,
    season,
    phase,
    team_id,
    lineup_key

-- Independent scoring conservation for IM03, including noncount technical FT records.
select f.dataset_id, f.game_id, f.offense_team_id
from "courtlens_im03_event"."analytics_marts"."mart_workbench_possession_factors" f
join "courtlens_im03_event"."public"."workbench_schedules" s
    on s.dataset_id = f.dataset_id and s.game_id = f.game_id
where f.points is distinct from (s.annotations_json->'conservation'->f.offense_team_id->>'points')::numeric
   or f.offensive_rebounds > f.orb_opportunities
   or f.ts_attempts <> f.fga + 0.44 * f.fta
   or f.possessions <= 0

select
    dataset_id,
    season,
    phase,
    team_id,
    player_id,
    max(player_name) as player_name,
    count(distinct game_id) as games_count,
    count(distinct stint_id) as stints_count,
    round(sum(duration_seconds)::numeric, 2) as total_seconds,
    round((sum(duration_seconds) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) as total_minutes,
    round(sum(possessions)::numeric, 2) as possessions_offensive,
    round(sum(opponent_possessions)::numeric, 2) as possessions_defensive,
    sum(points) as points_individual,
    sum(team_points) as team_points_on,
    sum(points_allowed) as points_allowed_on,
    sum(point_differential) as point_differential,
    case
        when sum(possessions) > 0
        then round(((sum(team_points) * 100.0) / sum(possessions))::numeric, 2)
        else null
    end as offensive_rating_on,
    case
        when sum(opponent_possessions) > 0
        then round(((sum(points_allowed) * 100.0) / sum(opponent_possessions))::numeric, 2)
        else null
    end as defensive_rating_on,
    case
        when sum(possessions) > 0 and sum(opponent_possessions) > 0
        then round((
            ((sum(team_points) * 100.0) / sum(possessions))
            - ((sum(points_allowed) * 100.0) / sum(opponent_possessions))
        )::numeric, 2)
        else null
    end as net_rating_on,
    sum(fgm) as fgm,
    sum(fga) as fga,
    sum(fg3m) as fg3m,
    sum(fg3a) as fg3a,
    sum(ftm) as ftm,
    sum(fta) as fta,
    sum(oreb) as oreb,
